The task, then, is to find it again.|Kullbee Sperado and [[Chirrut Îmwe]]|[[Guardians of the Whills (novel)|''Guardians of the Whills'']]}} '''Serolonis''', also known as '''Serralonis''',''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' was a [[desert]] [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]. It was known for the sport [[Riot Racing]], with events held at the [[Safa Toma Speedway]] on [[Safa Toma]], where spectators could place bets. Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|204}} it was not under the control of the recently [[Proclamation of the New Order|formed]] [[Galactic Empire]]. At that [[time]], [[Clone Force 99]] members [[Tech]], [[Wrecker]], and [[Omega]], as well as [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], arrived at the planet via a [[Star Commuter 2000]] to meet Cid's [[droid]] [[racer]], [[TAY-0]]. Cid later made a bet with the [[Dowutin]] [[crime lord]] [[Grini Millegi]] that TAY-0 would win the next race. However, [[Nosaurian]] racer [[Jet Venim]] won the race. Unable to pay, the members of the Bad Batch stepped up and instead made a new deal of paying double if they lost in the next race. With TAY-0 gone, Tech became the racer for Cid and won the race, thereby saving Cid from Millegi. [[Kullbee Sperado]] was on Serolonis when he was recruited by [[Saw Gerrera]] to join the [[Partisans]]. ==Description== Serolonis was a [[desert]] [[planet]] which featured mainly sand dunes and rocky terrain. From [[Realspace|space]], it looked like a [[Color|reddish-yellow]] ball with patches of green. At least one settlement was on the planet, the main attraction of which was the [[Safa Toma Speedway]], a racecourse with where people could watch [[Riot Racing]], a sport popular on the planet. By [[18 BBY]], the world was host to various criminals, [[smuggler]]s, and [[gambler]]s. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:CadBanesDemise-BoBFCh7.png|thumb|250px|right|Cad Bane and Boba Fett were originally going to be on Serolonis.]] Serolonis first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' episode "[[Faster]]", released on [[January 18]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} The planet was originally created for an [[The Clone Wars Legacy#Bounty Hunter Arc|unfinished arc]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' featuring [[Cad Bane]] and a young [[Boba Fett]] and is named after legendary [[Wikipedia:Italy|Italian]] [[Wikipedia:Western (genre)|Western]] director [[Wikipedia:Sergio Leone|Sergio Leone]]. Concept art of the planet for ''The Bad Batch'' was done by [[Clinton Felker]] and [[Molly Denmark]].{{SW|url=faster-concept-art-gallery|text="Faster" Concept Art Gallery | The Bad Batch}} While the episode's [[StarWars.com]] trivia gallery spells the planet's name as "Serolonis," the concept art gallery for the same episode renders the name as "Seralonis." The planet was first mentioned as "Serralonis" in the [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''{{'s}} information on the character [[Kullbee Sperado]], but it was not until the [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' that "Serralonis" was confirmed to be the same as Serolonis, as its entry for Sperado used the "Serolonis" spelling instead.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Serolonis}} *[[Star Wars Zero Company|''Star Wars'' Zero Company]] *{{TBB|Faster}} {{1st}} *[[Guardians of the Whills (novel)|''Guardians of the Whills'']] {{Mo}} *''[[Guardians of the Whills: The Manga]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stm}} {{ID|Serralonis}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/faster-episode-guide|text="Faster" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{1stID|Serolonis}} {{C|also as Seralonis}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' {{ID|Serralonis}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{SWYouTube|q0trVP56Cy0|Star Wars Celebration LIVE! 2025 - DAY 2}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-zero-company|text=Join the Ranks of ''Star Wars'' Zero Company}} *{{EASWYouTube|bd-3INhbefc|STAR WARS Zero Company - STAR WARS Celebration 2025 Panel Stream}} *{{SWYouTube|Ggo6OKeKNAY|Star Wars Zero Company | Official Announce Trailer}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Safa Toma |ja=セロロニス |ka=სეროლონისი }} [[Category:Desert planets]] [[Category:Kriz sector locations]] [[Category:Planets in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Planets in the Western Reaches]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Serolonis locations]] }}
